eyebrow: Problem 1: reversed CNOT on a Bell state
code:
Bell state: (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2) = [0.7071,0,0,0.7071]

reversed CNOT (control=q2, target=q1):
  |11> -> |01>,  others fixed

result: [0.7071, 0.7071, 0, 0] = (|00> + |01>)/sqrt(2)
caption: The symmetric-looking Bell state is NOT a fixed point of the reversed CNOT — compute it, don't guess.

eyebrow: Problem 3: CZ moves between Bell states
caption: Same measurement odds, different relative phase — a different member of the Bell-state family.
